label: log10(train rows)
definition: Base-10 log of training rows.

label: log10(test rows)
definition: Base-10 log of test rows.

label: log10(total rows)
definition: Base-10 log of train plus test rows.

label: log10(test/train)
definition: Base-10 log of the test-to-train row ratio.

label: log10(train rows/feature)
definition: Base-10 log of training rows per input feature.

label: feature count
definition: Total number of input features.

label: categorical count
definition: Number of declared categorical features.

label: numeric count
definition: Number of declared numerical features.

label: categorical fraction
definition: Categorical feature count divided by total feature count.

label: train missing fraction
definition: Mean missing-cell fraction in a deterministic sample of at most 50,000 training rows.

label: test missing fraction
definition: Mean missing-cell fraction in a deterministic sample of at most 50,000 test rows.

label: |missing-rate change|
definition: Absolute train-test difference in sampled missing-cell fraction.

label: constant-feature fraction
definition: Fraction of features with at most one sampled non-missing training value.

label: median categorical cardinality
definition: Median sampled training cardinality across categorical features.

label: high-cardinality cat fraction
definition: Fraction of categorical features with more than 50 sampled training levels.

label: unseen test-category fraction
definition: Mean sampled test-row share whose category was not observed in sampled training data.

label: median |numeric skew|
definition: Median absolute skewness over at most 200 sampled numerical features.

label: mean |numeric correlation|
definition: Mean absolute off-diagonal Pearson correlation over at most 100 numerical features and 5,000 rows.

label: regression indicator
definition: One for regression tasks and zero for classification tasks.

label: multiclass indicator
definition: One for classification tasks with more than two training classes.

label: class count
definition: Number of training target classes. Missing for regression.

label: minority-class share
definition: Smallest training class proportion. Missing for regression.

label: log10(class imbalance)
definition: Base-10 log of largest-to-smallest training class proportion. Missing for regression.

label: normalized target entropy
definition: Training class entropy divided by log(number of classes). Missing for regression.

label: effective class count
definition: Exponentiated training class entropy. Missing for regression.

label: regression target SD
definition: Training-target standard deviation. Missing for classification.

label: regression target IQR/SD
definition: Training-target IQR divided by standard deviation. Missing for classification.

label: regression target |skew|
definition: Absolute training-target skewness. Missing for classification.

label: regression target kurtosis
definition: Training-target excess kurtosis. Missing for classification.

label: regression target outlier fraction
definition: Training-target share outside the 1.5-IQR Tukey fences. Missing for classification.

label: domain AUC
definition: Cross-validated mixed-type train-versus-test domain ROC AUC.

label: mean numeric KS
definition: Mean train-test KS statistic across numerical features.

label: 90th-percentile numeric KS
definition: 90th percentile of sampled per-feature numerical KS statistics.

label: maximum numeric KS
definition: Maximum sampled per-feature numerical KS statistic.

label: median standardized Wasserstein
definition: Median sampled numerical Wasserstein distance divided by training SD.

label: median |log SD ratio|
definition: Median absolute log(test SD / train SD) across sampled numerical features.

label: mean categorical JS
definition: Mean train-test Jensen-Shannon divergence across categorical features.

label: 90th-percentile categorical JS
definition: 90th percentile of sampled per-feature categorical Jensen-Shannon divergences.

label: maximum categorical JS
definition: Maximum sampled per-feature categorical Jensen-Shannon divergence.

label: mean categorical TV
definition: Mean sampled categorical total-variation distance.

label: significant numeric fraction
definition: Bonferroni-significant fraction of numerical features.

label: significant categorical fraction
definition: Bonferroni-significant fraction of categorical features.

label: overall shift score
definition: Existing composite numerical/categorical/domain shift score.

label: IID-control indicator
definition: One for TabArena IID, Tschalzev IID or the zero-shift synthetic control.

label: temporal-design indicator
definition: One when the documented split is temporal or a temporal gap.

label: synthetic indicator
definition: One for synthetic datasets.

label: baseline normalized error
definition: Model-specific baseline error: 1-AUC for classification and RMSE/training-target-SD for regression.

label: baseline difficulty percentile
definition: Within-model and task-type percentile rank of baseline normalized error. Larger values indicate greater difficulty.

label: baseline fold SD
definition: Fold SD of baseline error, divided by training-target SD for regression.

label: baseline ROC AUC
definition: Model-specific inductive-baseline ROC AUC. Classification only.

label: baseline normalized RMSE
definition: Model-specific inductive-baseline RMSE divided by training-target SD. Regression only.

label: target-shift score (post-hoc)
definition: Classification target total variation or regression target KS. It uses test labels and is explanatory only.

label: regression target mean change/SD
definition: Absolute train-test target-mean change divided by training-target SD. This applies only to regression and uses test labels.
